operation.name: classify
operation.instruction: The first ref is the measurement record. The second ref is its host-checked interval: [lower,upper], or unknown. If the interval is unknown, return unknown. Otherwise use its endpoints directly. Let L and U be the lower and upper limits of the goal's acceptance interval, in mm. Return inside if lower >= L AND upper <= U; outside otherwise. Equality at either limit is inside.

rules.order: goals in the listed order; per goal quartet one forward then reversed, then quartet two forward then reversed (12 size-4 calls); then singletons case-major in singleton_order, each across the three goals in listed order (24 calls)
rules.call: sequential fresh processes; no memo reuse, retries, replacement calls or extension
rules.pass: every scheduled call wire-valid, entirely correct (every member exactly its label), within 300 s, route ok and accounting complete
rules.stop: the first call that is not entirely correct ends the attempt; unrun slots stay untested
